google.notes: Plugin static catalog, including preview entries; zero costs are the plugin placeholders, not a free-service claim.

google-vertex.notes: Same model definitions as the Google Vertex builder. Actual availability depends on project/location. Zero costs are plugin placeholders.

xai.notes: Plugin static catalog; several maxTokens values are explicitly conservative fallbacks in the source.

minimax.notes: Plugin text catalog; global API pricing, including the source cache-write placeholder for M3. OAuth/API runtime configuration remains separate.

minimax-portal.notes: Plugin text catalog; global API pricing, including the source cache-write placeholder for M3. OAuth/API runtime configuration remains separate.

anthropic-vertex.notes: Global-region catalog, standard pricing as of 2026-09-08. Regional availability/pricing differs; this metadata does not select a runtime region.

amazon-bedrock.notes: SDK built-in model and inference-profile IDs. Availability depends on AWS region/account; no live AWS discovery or credentials were used.

amazon-bedrock-mantle.notes: Only the five explicit Claude definitions, with per-model anthropic-messages API and post-2026-09-01 prices. The dynamic AWS /v1/models inventory is intentionally not collected.

openrouter.notes: SDK built-in inventory plus plugin defaults (plugin wins on duplicate IDs). Router-prefixed model IDs are preserved. Static snapshot, not current API discovery. Negative price sentinels (openrouter/auto) are omitted as unknown, not converted to zero.

openai-codex.notes: SDK built-ins plus plugin augmentation (plugin wins). GPT-6/5.6/5.5 use the plugin 272K budget and subscription cost placeholders. Deprecated replacements follow the plugin lifecycle map; actual subscription access is account-specific.

zai.notes: Agent snapshot baseline. The live upstream already has a larger catalog; overlapping upstream rows remain authoritative.
